_invalid_columns_selflink.distinct_findings: The `distinct_findings` / `trigger_counts` columns in this file are INVALID. Every broken_navigation firing on the deep_flow_site fixture came from a self-referential link -- an anchor resolving to the page already loaded (nav-support on support.html, sup-returns on support.html, nav-home on index.html). Clicking one reloads and correctly leaves the URL unchanged, which detect_bug_signals read as a broken link. The fixture's deterministic ceiling is 0, so these were never discoveries. Fixed 2026-08-27 in envs/action_registry.py (_is_self_link).

_claim_this_invalidates: '17 distinct findings' at the 4,000-step budget. It was already marked n=1; it is now also marked as counting self-link false positives. The depth result from this run (max_depth 5, mean_depth 0.38, 11 steps on the receipt) is unaffected and is the number worth citing.

wall_clock.idle_gaps_note: three gaps over 2 minutes (388, 150 and 545 minutes) — the machine slept
wall_clock.compute_note: ~75 minutes of actual compute, consistent with the 62 minutes the pre-fix Aug 17 run took at the same budget. An earlier claim of 7.5 hours per seed was elapsed time inflated by sleep and is withdrawn.

comparison_note: The matched-budget comparison is the 200-step, 3-seed table in
go_explore_deep_matched200.json. This file is the 20x-budget supplement: it shows
what the archive reaches when given room, not that it beats anything at parity.
At 200 steps go-explore is level with masked random on findings (11 [9-13] vs
10 [10-12]) and modestly ahead on depth (0.10 vs 0.04).
what_changed_since_the_aug_17_run: distinct_findings is now measured (17) rather than 0, which was a bug in the runner
reading a key that did not exist.
44 of 1285 returns failed, where the Aug 17 run reported 0. That is not a
regression: routes are now validated before being archived, so the archive climbs
deeper (routes of 5-9 steps into the order flow), and a deeper route has more places
to derail. A 3.4% return-failure rate at depth is the honest cost of the fix, and it
is exactly what returns_failed exists to surface.
